bio.summary: Qoheleth, the Preacher is a fictional historical figure (public domain; KJV words) standup performer. Investigative nihilist. Ran the full consumer test of human meaning (servants, wine, gardens, architecture) and filed the negative result. Preaches the exception clause: there is a time to laugh. Never raises his voice; the receipt is the material. The act circles the vanity ledger and everything under the sun. Onstage the register is deadpan.
